data.description:
## Context

F25 and F27 are approved. Exit-code guidance omits the completion path marked verdict_obtainable=false. Five public mutation wrappers lack client-facing documentation after the library write-surface split.

## Plan

- Document retryable raised LLMError failures and results marked verdict_obtainable=false as exit 11.
- Distinguish those paths from ordinary completion failure and nonretryable indeterminate outcomes.
- Document unlink, tag, untag, archive, and compact signatures, effects, errors, repository selection, event or storage effects, and publication behavior.
- Remove stale shell-history narration where it obscures current compact behavior.
- Change no public behavior.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] docs/exit-codes.md covers both implemented completion exit 11 paths.
- [ ] Ordinary completion failure and nonretryable indeterminate outcomes remain distinct.
- [ ] Each named mutation wrapper has accurate public documentation in source and docs/reuse-surface.md.
- [ ] Documentation reflects concurrent completion recovery changes present on refreshed origin/main.
- [ ] Focused exit-code and mutation interface tests, lint, and type checking pass.
- [ ] No public behavior changes.
data.title: Document completion retry outcomes and public mutation functions
